updateTime.description: Timestamp of the last update of this document

reportName.description: Name of the source report the document was ingested from

link_session_id.description: Identifier of the EDRS link session

geo_satellite_id.description: Identifier of the geostationary relay satellite (EDRS node)

mission.description: Mission the satellite belongs to (e.g. S1, S2)

doy.description: Day of year of the link session

planned_link_session_start.description: Planned start time of the EDRS link session

planned_link_session_stop.description: Planned stop time of the EDRS link session

moc_accept_status.description: Status of the MOC acceptance step of the link session

uplink_status.description: Status of the uplink step of the link session

spacecraft_execution.description: Status of the spacecraft execution step of the link session

edte_acquisition_status.description: Status of the EDTE acquisition step of the link session

dcsu_archive_status.description: Status of the DCSU archiving step of the link session

sfdap_dissem_status.description: Status of the SFDAP dissemination step of the link session

total_status.description: Overall status of the link session, aggregating the individual processing step statuses

ground_station.description: Ground station where the link session data was disseminated

dissemination_start.description: Start time of the data dissemination

dissemination_stop.description: Stop time of the data dissemination

cadus.description: Number of CADUs (Channel Access Data Units) processed during the link session

fer.description: Frame error rate of the link session

archived_data_size.description: Size of the archived data for the link session

disseminated_data.description: Volume of disseminated data for the link session

notes.description: Free-text notes about the link session

cams_tickets.description: Identifiers of the CAMS tickets linked to this link session

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the last CAMS ticket attached to this link session

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the last CAMS ticket attached to this link session

cams_origin.description: Origin of the linked CAMS ticket(s)

cams_description.description: Description of the linked CAMS ticket(s)

report_type.description: Type of the source report (daily, weekly or monthly)

report_name_daily.description: Name of the daily source report the document was ingested from

report_name_weekly.description: Name of the weekly source report the document was ingested from

report_name_monthly.description: Name of the monthly source report the document was ingested from
